title: Chapter 198 The Desire Of The Six Nations
content:
Chapter 198 The Desire Of The Six Nations

After meeting with King Wei, Zhong Yu led his troops to leave Wei State and head towards South Korea quickly.

According to the news that Zhong Yu has now, South Korea is now in a terrible state, and the country of the feature film is almost reduced to ruins.

Because the attack could not be defeated for a long time, the troops were sent out in a hurry, many supplies were not prepared, and the war consumed a lot, so the Qin army ordered to collect on the spot.

Now all the counties and counties in South Korea occupied by the Qin army are devastated. The Qin army has never been a responsible person, but is full of greedy and tyrannical people like the grassland people.

They vented the anger accumulated in the war directly on the people of South Korea. Although due to the ban and the interests of Qin, they did not kill them.

But there are still some scenes that should be seen after the soldiers and bandits pass.

For example, robbery, rape by strong women, random beating of Korean civilians, and wanton recruitment of civilian husbands!

All in all, in a word, the people of South Korea are now under the rule of Qin, and their lives are really worse than pigs and dogs.

And after such a period of chaos, South Korea's production was completely destroyed, a large area of fertile land was abandoned and burned, and various cities were also demolished. The people in the city either fled or were forcibly recruited by the Qin army. military service.

After such a catastrophe, around Xinzheng, which was originally densely populated, there are only a dozen cities left in South Korea with a population of 800,000 to 900,000.

Now, except for the hundreds of thousands of people who have been recruited to serve as soldiers, almost all of them died. Of the remaining 700,000 people, tens of thousands were also killed by the Qin army, and another 200,000 to 300,000 escaped him. Only 400,000 people were left, shivering and lingering on under the monstrous power of the Qin army.

If Zhong Yu doesn't go to save South Korea, even if South Korea finally defends and drags down the enemy army outside the city, the dragging Qin army will retreat without fighting.

But South Korea is almost abolished. In Xinzheng City, there are only 50,000 defenders left. When the reinforcements led by Zhong Yu arrive, there may be even fewer. Twenty to thirty thousand will be good.

South Korea cannot be abolished, at least not before completing his mission. Zhong Yu still needs South Korea to contain Qin, and use it to cause the melee in the Central Plains after defeating Qin.

"It seems that breaking the siege of Xinzheng is also to benefit South Korea, so that South Korea can continue to cheer up!" Zhong Yu secretly made up his mind in his heart.

Now that South Korea has been abandoned, the surrounding areas of Xinzheng are in ruins, and even the help of the South Korean government is needed, which will drag down South Korea's national strength.

Now that Xinzheng is abolished, then find another free land, give him to South Korea, let South Korea use it as the foundation, and it will be enough to rise again!

This time, the alliance and the crusade against the Qin State, in addition to resisting the aggressive trend of the Qin State and saving the fate of their own country's decline, it also means regaining the country's lost ground and rising again.

Among them, what the Chu State wanted to take back were mainly Nanyang County and Nanjun County, the two most affluent lands in the Chu State, and the original capital of the Chu State.

Zhao Guo, on the other hand, wanted to take back Taiyuan County, Yanmen County, and Yunzhong County, which was seized by the Huns. And the most important thing is the Shangdang County, which was received from South Korea and was subsequently robbed by the Qin State in the Changping War. That is the eternal pain in Zhao Guoren's heart.

As for the Wei people, their targets were Dong Jun, Tao Jun, and the surrounding area of Ye City in the south of Zhao Guo HD.

As for South Korea, they don't have any extravagant hopes. They just want to keep themselves, and South Korea will not be destroyed. By the way, they will expand a dozen cities outward, and they will be satisfied.

Yan Guo, that's a soy saucer, unwilling, forced to come here by his own imperial country.

After all, Yan State and Qin State do not border at all, even if they snatch the territory lost by Qin State and get it in their hands, they will not be able to hold on to the end.

Just like Wei Guo worked hard, spent most of the national power, and wiped out a Zhongshan country like Xiaoqiang. In the end, because the distance was too far, it was benefited by Zhao Guo, and now it has become more than half of the land between Zhao Guodai County and HD County.

"When the time comes, the two original territories of South Korea, Sanchuan County and Hanoi County in Qin State, will be returned to South Korea. With these two counties, South Korea's strength can also be greatly increased!" Zhong Yu said. This idea came to mind.

Sanchuan County and Hanoi County, originally under the governance of South Korea, were the most affluent places. Especially Sanchuan County, which was originally used by the Zhou royal family as a way out for themselves, has been taken care of and fully developed.

Later, it was taken over by South Korea, and it was carefully developed. Now it is taken by Qin, who advocates farming and fighting to build a country, and has been repaired for water conservancy and transportation. .

If South Korea gets these two counties, let alone restore Xinzheng City's lost strength, it will restore its reputation as a great country again, and it will be nothing more than a matter of flipping hands.

...

Under the city of Xinzheng, the Qin army, which had been attacking fiercely before, became completely slowed down.

The reason is that their coach, Nei Sten, forced too much, 100,000 people, but within three days, more than half of them were lost, and 50,000 people died.

Today's Qin army, although they are brave and good at fighting, and they are happy to hear the war, but the huge casualty ratio and the incompetence of the coach have greatly affected their fighting spirit.

A total of 200,000 troops, less than 50,000 in less than a month, this cruel casualty ratio is enough to collapse the army.

After all, this Qin army was not led by a general who convinced them. Instead, it was led by a surrendered general from South Korea, which had hit their morale in the first place.

Now that so many people have died, the resentment in the army has long been rising everywhere, and the undercurrent is raging.

If it weren't for the harsh criminal laws of these Qin soldiers and their loyalty to Qin, they might have rebelled long ago.

However, even so, it is absolutely impossible to let them continue to attack the city. If they are forced again, even if they are loyal to Qin, they will not be able to bear it.

In fact, this was also a mistake made by King Qin Yingzheng.

He originally thought that with the leadership of Nei Sten, a South Korean general, he could break through South Korea from the inside and achieve his goal at the lowest cost and in the shortest time.

Where did you go to think that South Korea is not what it used to be today, with the United Vertical Alliance as a backer, it is not like in history, when they heard the news of the arrival of the South Korean army, the whole country surrendered directly.

Instead, they resisted stubbornly, and a whole country came to fight against Qin and smashed South Korea into ruins, and they had no intention of surrendering.

Now this embarrassing situation has been created.
